name: sumo squat floor touch
description: A wide-stance squat in which you touch the floor between your feet. It trains the glutes, thighs and hip mobility.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out.
Push your hips back and squat down.
Touch the floor with your fingertips between your feet.
Keep your chest lifted and your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.
